tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Sphere at infinity is round] In the zero-asymptotic-curvature case above, $S_\infty (M,p)$ is isometric to the round $2$-sphere. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch The complement of the cone vertex is orientable because $M$ is orientable. Hence its constant-positive-curvature link is an orientable surface, necessarily $S^2$ with its round metric.

□
